title: I stopped drowning in browser tabs, thanks to this clever AI tool | ZDNET
summary: ZDNET introduces Karakeep, an AI-powered tool to manage and organize browser tabs, offering solutions for tabulomania and compulsive tab usage. It features AI-generated keywords and summaries, with options for cloud or self-hosted use. Pro users gain access to more bookmarks and storage.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a neutral sentiment as it introduces a useful tool for a common problem without significant market impact or financial implications.
